how_this_was_built:
BY READING THE TITLES. Every ACTIVE deposit whose title names the framework was listed and read — 183 of them — and sorted by hand into the divisions the framework declares.

THE WORD 'PROVENANCE' DOES TWO UNRELATED JOBS IN THIS ARCHIVE, and no regex separates them. About a hundred of the 183 are PROVENANCE DOCUMENTS: heteronym registrations, canon nodes, entity anchors — 'Sappho — Canon Provenance Node', 'HETERONYM PROVENANCE Rev. Ayanna Vox', 'Rhys Owens: Author Provenance Document'. Those are documentation OF an entity and belong to the heteronyms body. They are not provenance erasure and every earlier sweep admitted them.

THREE PRIOR VERSIONS OF THIS BODY WERE BUILT BY PATTERN-MATCHING AND ARE DISCARDED. Each was a better regex over the same undifferentiated field. This one is a reading.
